newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Kanematsu makes splash in Taiwan grain market.
newsitem.headline: Kanematsu makes splash in Taiwan grain market.

text.p: A major grain purchase by the Hui Shung Group has introduced a new player to Taiwan's grains and oilseeds market -- Japanese trading house Kanematsu.
"Kanematsu made a strong appearance by providing Thursday's shipment at a low price," a grain trader said.
Kanematsu's bid for the 54,000-tonne shipment of corn and soybeans was about US$10,000 lower than Taiwan's key supplier, U.S. firm Cargill Inc, the trader added.
Kanematsu is represented in Taiwan by Sun Ford Corp, an ambitious and diversified trading company.
Thursday's tender award was the first under an April 1 Kanematsu-Sun Ford accord to supply grain and oilseeds to Taiwan, a Sun Ford executive said.
Sun Ford is also the local agent for Metropolitan Life Insurance Co of the United States and has plans to build a power plant in Taiwan's Chiayi county, industry sources said.
Before joining up with Kanematsu, Sun Ford imported feed corn from Thailand.
